purpose: I rent a house with a roommate and things got messy. We were friends first and moved in casually, but now there’s confusion about rent timing, utilities, guests staying over, parking spots, noise late at night, shared cleaning, food in the fridge, and damage responsibility. They sometimes pay late and say they’ll catch up next check. I don’t necessarily want to kick them out, I just need structure and less drama. Need something practical that sets rent due dates, split bills, guest rules, common area expectations, notice if someone moves out, damages, and a calm process to solve issues before they blow up.
title: Agreement
